scaleme.midnightconfig.title: ScaleMe
scaleme.midnightconfig.handDesc: Adjust how your held item looks in your hand
scaleme.midnightconfig.enableHandItemTra: Turns on the custom held item positioning. Disable this to restore the default look and avoid conflicts with other mods.
scaleme.midnightconfig.itemScale.tooltip:
How big or small the item in your hand appears.
Smaller values make it tiny, larger values make it huge.
Shifts the item in your hand to the left or right.
Negative values move it left, positive values move it right.
Shifts the item in your hand up or down.
Negative values move it down, positive values move it up.
Shifts the item in your hand closer to or further from your screen.
Negative values push it away, positive values bring it closer.
scaleme.midnightconfig.itemRotationX.too: Tilts the item in your hand up or down.
scaleme.midnightconfig.itemRotationY.too: Rotates the item in your hand to the left or right.
scaleme.midnightconfig.itemRotationZ.too: Spins the item in your hand clockwise or counterclockwise.
scaleme.midnightconfig.animDesc: Adjust how your held item animates
scaleme.midnightconfig.enableAnimOverrid: Turns on the custom animation settings below. Disable this to keep the default Minecraft swing animations.
scaleme.midnightconfig.disableSwingBobbi: Prevents the item from bouncing up and down when you swing it.
scaleme.midnightconfig.ignoreSwingSpeedE: Potion effects like Haste or Mining Fatigue will no longer change how fast your arm swings.
scaleme.midnightconfig.swingAnimationSpe:
How fast your arm swings when you attack or use an item.
Lower values slow it down, higher values speed it up.
scaleme.midnightconfig.disableSwingAnima: Completely removes the arm swing animation. Your arm stays still when you click.
scaleme.midnightconfig.viewDescription: Control your crosshair and camera behaviour
scaleme.midnightconfig.enableCrosshairIn: Shows the crosshair when the camera is behind your character.
Shows the crosshair when the camera is facing your character from the front.
Removes the option to flip the camera to face your character.
